segments.text: Okay everyone, welcome to the Atlas kickoff. Thanks for joining.
Sara will own the vendor evaluation and send a shortlist by next Friday.
Now, last quarter. As you can see, this one went up a lot, revenue is the big story.
Churn dropped too, and that is thanks to the support team. We are also hiring.
Quick aside, please do not forget your timesheets.
So the architecture is roughly this. The two boxes on top feed the middle layer, and everything lands in the bottom node.
We decided to keep the bottom node as a single service for now.
Regarding the handbook, the only policy that matters this month is that backups run nightly.
Marcus, can you check the interns have mentors by the end of the month?
Great, that is all for today, thanks everyone.
